title: The number of Laplacian eigenvalues of trees less than one
summary: Let $m_T[0,1)$ denote the number of Laplacian eigenvalues of a tree $T$ that are strictly less than $1$. Guo, Xue and Liu \cite{GXL} proved that every tree $T$ of diameter $d$ satisfies $m_T[0,1)\ge \lceil(d+1)/3\rceil$, and that this bound is sharp when $d\equiv2\pmod3$. It is classical that every graph of diameter $d$ has domination number at least $\lceil(d+1)/3\rceil$.
